basic_details.job_title: MGUG Consultant Neurosurgeon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur (MGUG) has advertised one Consultant Neurosurgeon post. Applications go by email to [email protected], with a detailed resume and supporting documents, on or before 05 December 2026. The email subject must be "Application for Neurosurgeon". The notice is dated 19.11.2026 and carries Advertisement No. MGUG/Recruitment/2026/11/005.

qualification.details: MBBS, MS (General Surgery) & M.Ch. (Neurosurgery) / DNB (Neurosurgery) from a recognized Medical College/Institution. Valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council. Sound clinical knowledge and expertise in the diagnosis and surgical management of neurological and neurosurgical disorders. Ability to evaluate and manage neurosurgical emergencies, including head injuries, spinal injuries, intracranial haemorrhage and other acute neurological conditions. Proficiency in interpreting relevant neuroimaging investigations, including CT and MRI scans. | Experience as a Consultant Neurosurgeon in a multispecialty hospital. Experience in performing cranial and spinal neurosurgical procedures. Expertise in the management of traumatic brain injuries, brain tumours, spinal disorders, intracranial haemorrhage and cerebrovascular conditions. Experience in managing critically ill neurosurgical patients in ICU/HDU settings. Knowledge of minimally invasive neurosurgical techniques and advanced surgical procedures. Experience in academic activities, clinical teaching and research will be an added advantage. | For the full eligibility terms, candidates should refer to the official notification.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice does not describe the interview in more detail.

content_sections.heading: About MGUG
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur is a multidisciplinary university on a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur. It offers higher education in Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Health & Life Science, Engineering & Technology, Allied & Healthcare and Management & Commerce. The campus has an upcoming multi-specialty hospital of 1,800 beds. The University also has two functional multispecialty hospitals in Gorakhpur: Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (650+ beds) and Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (300+ beds). Its address is Arogya Dham, Balapar Road, Sonbarsa, Gorakhpur-273007.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The University invites applications from eligible, qualified and experienced medical professionals. Eligible candidates may send their detailed resume along with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 05 December 2026. Prepare a detailed resume and the supporting documents. The notice does not list the documents by name. Write the email subject exactly as: Application for Neurosurgeon. Send the email to [email protected] on or before 05 December 2026. The notice prints no separate application form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: MBBS, MS (General Surgery) & M.Ch. (Neurosurgery) / DNB (Neurosurgery) from a recognized Medical College/Institution. Valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council. Sound clinical knowledge and expertise in the diagnosis and surgical management of neurological and neurosurgical disorders. Ability to evaluate and manage neurosurgical emergencies, including head injuries, spinal injuries, intracranial haemorrhage and other acute neurological conditions. Proficiency in interpreting relevant neuroimaging investigations, including CT and MRI scans. Experience as a Consultant Neurosurgeon in a multispecialty hospital. Experience in performing cranial and spinal neurosurgical procedures. Expertise in the management of traumatic brain injuries, brain tumours, spinal disorders, intracranial haemorrhage and cerebrovascular conditions. Experience in managing critically ill neurosurgical patients in ICU/HDU settings. Knowledge of minimally invasive neurosurgical techniques and advanced surgical procedures. Experience in academic activities, clinical teaching and research will be an added advantage. For the full eligibility terms, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.pay: Salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience as per University rules

faq.question: Q1. How many Consultant Neurosurgeon posts has MGUG advertised?
faq.answer: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur has advertised 01 post of Consultant Neurosurgeon.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGUG Consultant Neurosurgeon post?
faq.answer: The resume and supporting documents must be emailed on or before 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the MGUG Consultant Neurosurgeon post?
faq.answer: The notice requires MBBS, MS (General Surgery) & M.Ch. (Neurosurgery) / DNB (Neurosurgery) from a recognized Medical College/Institution, plus valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the MGUG Consultant Neurosurgeon post?
faq.answer: Send a detailed resume along with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What subject line should the application email carry?
faq.answer: The subject of the email must be "Application for Neurosurgeon".

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the MGUG Consultant Neurosurgeon?
faq.answer: The notice says salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience as per University rules. No amount is printed.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which experience is desirable for the MGUG Consultant Neurosurgeon post?
faq.answer: Desirable experience includes work as a Consultant Neurosurgeon in a multispecialty hospital, cranial and spinal neurosurgical procedures, and managing critically ill neurosurgical patients in ICU/HDU settings.

faq.question: Q9. Can the University withdraw or not fill the post?
faq.answer: Yes. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts advertised and to withdraw the advertisement, partly or wholly, at any time without assigning any reason.
